journals.title: Nature
journals.review_anonymity: single-anonymous; authors may request double-anonymous review
journals.limits: Initial submission: summary about 200 words; typical six-page Article 2,500 words and four display items; typical eight-page Article 4,300 words and five to six display items; 50 main references maximum.
journals.latex_policy: At initial submission, submit a single PDF; LaTeX source is requested only after acceptance and does not need visual journal formatting.
journals.publication_license: Hybrid subscription or Gold Open Access; Open Access licence selected at acceptance.

journals.title: Nature Communications
journals.review_anonymity: single-anonymous by default; double-anonymous and transparent-review options are available where selected
journals.limits: No prescribed structure or length is required at initial submission; consult the current formatting instructions before revision.
journals.latex_policy: Project-authored scaffold only; it is not an official Nature Communications kit.
journals.publication_license: Fully open access; check the current article licence at submission.

journals.title: Scientific Reports
journals.review_anonymity: Consult the current submission system for the selected article type.
journals.limits: Guidance: ideally no more than 11 typeset pages, 4,500 main-text words excluding abstract, Methods, references, and legends; title 20 words; abstract 200 words.
journals.latex_policy: The journal points LaTeX authors to the generic Springer Nature journal-article template. It is not a venue-specific Scientific Reports style.
journals.publication_license: Fully open access; verify the selected article licence before submission.
